title: Chicken Tikka Masala
subtitle: Marinated grilled chicken in a rich tomato and cream curry sauce
excerpt: Tender marinated chicken pieces grilled until charred, then simmered in a creamy, fragrant tomato and spice sauce. Britain's most popular curry, now thoroughly part of the national repertoire.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chicken tikka masala is a dish of South Asian origin that became one of the most widely eaten dishes in Britain. Its precise origin is disputed: it may have originated in restaurants in Glasgow or Birmingham or Birmingham in the 1960s or 1970s, possibly created by British Pakistani restaurant cooks who added a creamy tomato sauce to the dry tikka (marinated and grilled chicken pieces) to suit British tastes for a sauced curry. In 2001 a UK government minister described it as Britain's true national dish. Despite its murky origin, it is now considered a British-Indian classic. The defining features are the two-stage cooking: the chicken is first marinated in yoghurt and spices and grilled (producing the char and flavour of tandoor-cooked tikka), then finished in a rich tomato and cream masala sauce.

recipeTools.notes: A large saucepan for the sauce. A baking tray and grill for the tikka.

content.text: The two-stage cooking matters. The chicken goes under the grill at the highest setting until it picks up dark, slightly charred patches. That charring is the tikka element and gives the dish its smoky flavour. The masala sauce is cooked separately, and the grilled chicken goes in only at the end for 5 minutes. Any longer and the chicken loses its char and becomes a stewed texture.

items.preparation: boneless, skinless, cut into large chunks

content.text: Mix the yoghurt, garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, lemon juice, and 1 teaspoon of salt in a bowl. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight.

Grill the marinated chicken on a baking tray under the highest setting for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through. Meanwhile, make the sauce: fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, garam masala, and paprika. Cook for 2 minutes. Add the tinned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.

Blend the sauce until smooth. Return to the pan. Stir in the cream and season with the remaining salt. Add the grilled chicken to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander. Serve with basmati rice and naan.
